_comment: Master Strike ext_id -> {status, handler, wp, decision} provenance overlay for the effect-implementation index's Master Strike rows (WP-867 / D-24810). Strike IDENTITY (one row per Mastermind: extId / name / set / mechanic 'master-strike') is enumerated automatically from the mastermind card data by scripts/build-effect-implementation-index.mjs, so every Mastermind's Master Strike appears in the index without an entry here; this file curates ONLY status/handler/wp/decision for Masterminds whose printed strike has an arm in mastermindStrikeHandler (the WP-507 tactic-provenance pattern). A Mastermind absent from this map defaults to status 'unmarked' with blank handler/wp/decision -- the honest 'no handler ran' signal, never a fabricated attribution; at runtime its strike records a 'master-strike' hollow effect. wp / decision name the WP and decision that made the printed strike resolve IN FULL (so co2e Doctor Octopus and Loki cite WP-397 / D-24200 and WP-398 / D-24201, which finished the branches D-24192 left open, and both Red Skull rows cite WP-577 / D-24386, which superseded the D-24188 auto-pick). 'deferred' marks an arm that resolves the strike only partially (General Ross: the face flip runs, the named follow-on is logged as not modeled). An engine test (packages/game-engine/src/rules/mastermindStrike.unresolved.test.ts) runs the real dispatcher for every executable / deferred row and fails if one records a hollow, and the generator fails on a key that matches no Mastermind. Keyed by ${setAbbr}-mastermind-${mastermindSlug}-master-strike; keys sorted.
